name: HyperLend Pooled (Aave v3 fork)

requirements.label: Admin power is not a bare key
A confirmed delay before changes apply, no bypass
Bypass paths of the delay checked and ruled out
Price feed not under one hand
No key shared with another tracked protocol

exit_window: a delay with a bypass, or one not ruled out

narrative.summary: Upgrades sit behind a 7-day timelock and risk and listing changes behind a 6-hour one, each proposed by a 4-of-8 Safe and executed by a separate 5-of-9 Safe. The score follows the weaker 6-hour path.
narrative.detail: Timelock A (7 days) covers pool upgrades, POOL_ADMIN and ACL admin; Timelock B (6 hours) covers RISK_ADMIN and ASSET_LISTING_ADMIN (caps, new listings). The proposing Governance Safe and executing Treasury Safe share no owner and execution is not open to anyone: mitigating, not scored. EMERGENCY_ADMIN is two Safes (3-of-8 and 4-of-6) with no delay that can pause but, per Aave v3 semantics, not move funds; 5 of the 8 Governance signers also sign the 3-of-8 one. Not traced: the price feeds behind the oracle. Listed reserves inherit Kinetiq kHYPE and Unit treasury authority. DefiLlama TVL about $474.3M (2026-09-17).
